geometry_edits.rationale: Strengthen the continuous longitudinal curve to keep the mass unified while giving the upper profile a more deliberate section response.
Reduce the bend slightly so the silhouette remains calm and programmatic rather than over-sculpted.
Push the cantilevered portion higher in the mass so the ground edge reads more open and publicly responsive.
Add a carved public court tied to the dominant mass to create a stronger ground threshold and usable open space at the frontage.
Keep the court bounded but clearly legible, avoiding an over-large subtraction that would break the primary bar.
Open the court toward the access edge to align the public void with the street threshold.
Make the public court the new root so the dominant bar remains in ancestry while the threshold logic becomes primary.

graph_edits.rationale: Introduce a more legible stepped upper envelope so the dominant bar reads as a capacity-bearing continuous mass rather than a plain extrusion.
Preserve the long horizontal bar orientation that matches the current dominant gesture.
Align the subtractive public response to the verified access edge so the ground threshold becomes semantically legible.
Broaden the carve slightly to make the entry/court read as a usable public void rather than a minor nick.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low-to-mid-rise mass with a simple dominant bar and a modestly stepped/curved upper profile. Across the four views it is legible as one object, not a set of colliding solids, so hierarchy and repair integrity are strong. The parcel relation is acceptable: the mass sits within the boundary and does not merely fill a box, though the open-space figure is weak. The blue access edge is acknowledged only lightly; there is no clearly carved public void or strong entry seam, so the ground threshold is underdeveloped for neighborhood living. Program fit is still plausible because the form can support mixed neighborhood use, but it remains closer to a compact generic bar than a fully articulated active-edge building. The stepped/curved roofline is coherent rather than arbitrary, so non-stair silhouette scores well without over-rewarding the step.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped/stacked upper mass over a clear lower datum; keep the ground reading compact while allowing upper variation.
